transcript.text: Hello, this is a call from Mumbai Bank. May I speak with Rakesh Sharma?
Yes, this is Rakesh Sharma speaking. How can I help you?

Thank you for confirming. I am calling regarding your Mumbai Bank credit card. As of today, your minimum amount due is Rs 4,820, which was due on 2026-10-15. I wanted to check when you will be able to make this payment. Could you please let me know if you are able to pay this amount, and if so, by which date?
I’m really sorry, but I’m not sure when I’ll be able to pay. I lost my job a few weeks ago, so I don’t have any money right now.
